title: Enchanted Forest Sorceress
description: A woman in a flowing, multicolored starry robe and blue hood stands in a mystical night forest, gazing upward. Ethereal spirits, glowing fish-like creatures, and swirling colorful ribbons orbit around her amid ancient trees, lotus flowers, and a starry sky.
prompt: A mystical woman wearing a long flowing hooded robe covered in stars and galaxies stands in an enchanted night forest, looking up as colorful glowing fish spirits and translucent ghostly figures swirl around her in a vortex of rainbow ribbons and magical energy, ancient twisted trees, glowing lotus flowers on the ground, bioluminescent atmosphere, fantasy digital art
